history.summary: A neighbourhood Hanuman shrine in Block G, Sector 22, Noida (per geocoded address). No published history or antiquity was found; it is a local place of daily worship, busy on Tuesdays and at Hanuman Jayanti.

name: Hanuman Mandir, Noida Sector 22
town_description: Noida (New Okhla Industrial Development Authority) is a planned city in western Uttar Pradesh on the Yamuna's eastern bank, part of the National Capital Region. Laid out in the 1970s-80s, it grew into a major IT, media and manufacturing hub with wide avenues, metro connectivity and dense residential sectors; Sector 22 is one of its older central sectors.

travel.airport: Indira Gandhi International Airport, Delhi (~35 km)
travel.railway: New Delhi Railway Station (~25 km); nearest metro: Noida City Centre (Blue Line)
travel.road: Sector 22 is in central Noida on city roads; autos, cabs and metro feeders available

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; Tuesdays and Hanuman Jayanti are the busiest days.
visitor_information.opening_hours: 4:00 AM - 11:00 PM daily (per the temple's business listing; confirm locally).
